extra.final_summary: The data had three issues: (1) 'island' column had case and space variants ('Dream ' and 'torgersen') which were normalized to 'Dream' and 'Torgersen'; (2) 'body_mass_g' was stored as text with commas (e.g. '3,150'), which was converted to numeric; (3) three rows had negative 'flipper_length_mm' values, which are impossible, so they were excluded. After fixes, the total body mass by species is: Adelie: 3,667,250 grams, Chinstrap: 55,625 grams, Gentoo: 70,175 grams.
